claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The motivation states the work funds a part-time Oura maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD, with 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve described before the final fee-inclusive total.
Oura is described as a Rust-native pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.
Oura is claimed to support multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The proposal states Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and links to the public GitHub repository.
The proposal claims Oura is used across the ecosystem for indexing, monitoring, analytics, and real-time event processing.
The proposal states Oura was previously funded twice through Project Catalyst in Funds 9 and 13 for feature development.
The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting, documentation, audited results, and audit materials.

The proposal states funds will be managed through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve and Project-Specific Smart Contracts with specified addresses, multisignature authorization rules, external oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Oura maintenance administered by Intersect, presenting Oura as open-source Cardano infrastructure with public repository metrics, prior funding history, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based treasury oversight.
